gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-scope-one: Conthrax goes wide and geometric, its capitals barely clearing the lowercase. Scope One follows in a traditional serif, with stubby ascenders and generous counters that spill into the space around each line.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-slabo-13px: Bookish and dignified, Slabo 13px opens its rounded letters wide enough to read at a glance. Slabo 13px carries a classic serif texture down the page without tiring, while Conthrax stays above it as a single clean thread of display lettering.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified and editorial, Suwannaphum stands tall in the lowercase, with a c that gapes like a bent paperclip. Suwannaphum would keep a long passage feeling weighty and squared-off, while Conthrax draws its heading in one smooth, toothpaste-like line.
gen-dafont-conthrax-instrument-sans: Conthrax draws wide, geometric letters in a single smooth line. Shrink that heading, though, and its tall-bodied shapes lose their punch, while Instrument Sans stays crisp even when enlarged, its c ends pointing apart like pincers.
gen-dafont-conthrax-inter: Inter has counters that breathe like a cut reed and a smooth, tube-like look to every line. Inter is the one to settle into for text, whereas Conthrax is built to be seen, bending its geometric tubing into a loud, wide heading.
gen-dafont-conthrax-mulish: Mulish has no thick-and-thin modulation at all, just horseshoe-open apertures and a large x-height under short ascenders. And Conthrax, wide and geometric above it, wants to be the larger of the two, so a modest size for Mulish is a fair suggestion.
gen-dafont-conthrax-roboto-slab: Wide, bent-tube geometry up top, then structure below. Roboto Slab holds a dense middle zone with open-throated a, c, e and s, but blow it up large beside a small Conthrax heading and the slab-serif starts to overpower it.
gen-dafont-conthrax-rubik: Soft, round, and quietly generous, Rubik sets big lowercase against its capitals with open shapes that stay clear. And Conthrax does the loud work, its heading strokes blunt and geometric, while Rubik does the patient work of carrying the text.
gen-dafont-cowboys-fs-asap: Asap reads with open, arcing c forms and a lowercase that nearly matches its capitals in height. Asap keeps a long passage moving smoothly, a sharp contrast to Cowboys, whose rustic letters stand far apart.
gen-dafont-cowboys-fs-epilogue: Cowboys spaces its stems far apart, each letter traced in a laser-etched line of constant width. But Epilogue is the one that carries the reading, with curvy, wire-like monoline letters and a tall lowercase that Cowboys, rustic and authoritative, never tries to match.
